zh.title: VCS 变更
zh.noSession: 先打开一个项目会话，再查看变更。
zh.noRepo: 未发现 Git / SVN 仓库。可输入相对子目录后重新扫描。
zh.binary: 二进制或受限内容无法按文本比较
zh.stale: 内容发生变化，请刷新后重试。
zh.scanHint: 仅扫描当前目录及一级子目录，不递归深入 · 缓存 5 分钟后过期
zh.truncated: 已达到扫描上限。输入相对子目录并重新扫描以补充其他位置。
zh.fallback: 高级编辑器不可用，已切换为基础左右文本对比。
zh.approximate: 内容较大，使用近似行对齐。
zh.commitNoChanges: 相对此基线无文件变更
zh.historyListOnly: 本地 HEAD 历史；选择提交及文件查看只读文本差异。
zh.historySearch: 筛选已加载提交（作者 / 摘要 / SHA）
zh.historyNoMatch: 已加载提交中无匹配项；可继续加载更多。
zh.historyLimit: 已达到历史浏览范围上限，仍有更早提交未显示。
zh.autoRefresh: 手动或窗口聚焦时刷新
zh.searchShortcut: Ctrl / ⌘ + F 搜索；Esc 清空搜索
zh.fileShortcut: Alt + ← / → 切换上一个或下一个文件
zh.pathCopied: 文件路径已复制到剪贴板。
zh.revisionTitle: 本地版本 A/B 比较
zh.revisionScope: 仅选择已加载的提交；直接比较 A → B，不使用合并基点。
zh.revisionEmpty: 两个版本没有文件变更。
zh.fileHistoryScope: 固定提交快照下的精确路径历史；不追踪重命名前路径，同路径删除后重建的记录也会包含。
zh.blameScope: 所选提交的 UTF-8 普通文本，最多显示前 500 行；不包含工作区修改。
zh.blameLimit: 仅显示前 500 行，结果已截断。
zh.historicalTreeScope: 所选提交的目录条目；每页 100 项。不打开文件、不跟随符号链接或子模块。

en.title: VCS changes
en.noSession: Open a project session to inspect its changes.
en.noRepo: No Git / SVN repositories discovered. Try a relative subdirectory and rescan.
en.binary: Binary or restricted content cannot be compared as text
en.stale: Content changed. Refresh and try again.
en.scanHint: Scan current directory and immediate children only · cache expires after 5 minutes
en.truncated: Discovery limit reached. Enter a relative subdirectory and rescan to include another location.
en.fallback: Advanced editor unavailable. Showing basic side-by-side text comparison.
en.textTruncated: Only the first 2000 lines are displayed.
en.commitNoChanges: No file changes against this baseline
en.historyListOnly: Local HEAD history. Select a commit and file to view a read-only text diff.
en.historyNoMatch: No matches in loaded commits; you can load more if available.
en.historyLimit: History browsing limit reached; older commits are not shown.
en.autoRefresh: Refresh manually or on window focus
en.searchShortcut: Ctrl / ⌘ + F to search; Esc clears search
en.fileShortcut: Alt + ← / → switches the previous or next file
en.pathCopied: File path copied to the clipboard.
en.copyFailed: Unable to copy the file path.
en.revisionScope: Select loaded commits only. Compare A → B directly, not via merge-base.
en.revisionEmpty: No file changes between these revisions.
en.fileHistoryScope: Exact-path history at the pinned commit. Does not follow renames; includes deletion and recreation at the same path.
en.blameScope: UTF-8 regular text at the selected commit, first 500 lines at most. Working changes are excluded.
en.blameLimit: Only the first 500 lines are shown; result truncated.
en.historicalTreeScope: Entries at the selected commit; 100 per page. Files are not opened; symlinks and submodules are not followed.
